questions.stem: What is the purpose of a laboratory thermometer?
choices: To measure the temperature of boiling water
To measure the temperature of liquids in a laboratory
To measure the temperature of the atmosphere
questions.solution: A laboratory thermometer is specifically designed for measuring the temperature of liquids in a laboratory setting. The other options describe the functions of a clinical thermometer or other types of thermometers.

questions.stem: What is the normal temperature of a healthy human being?
questions.solution: The normal temperature of a healthy human being is typically around 37.0 °C, which is the standard in the metric system. 98.6 °C is a Fahrenheit measurement and not the standard metric value. The other options, 32.0 °C and 27.0 °C, are significantly lower than normal body temperature and would indicate hypothermia.

hi.stem: एक स्वस्थ मनुष्य का सामान्य तापमान क्या होता है?
hi.solution: एक स्वस्थ मनुष्य का सामान्य तापमान आमतौर पर 37.0 °C के आसपास होता है, जो मीट्रिक प्रणाली में मानक है। 98.6 °C फारेनहाइट मापन है और मीट्रिक मानक नहीं है। अन्य विकल्प, 32.0 °C और 27.0 °C, सामान्य शारीरिक तापमान से काफी कम हैं और हाइपोथर्मिया को दर्शाते हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for scientific concepts.

mr.stem: एका आरोग्यपूर्ण माणसाची सामान्य तापमान किती असते?
mr.solution: एका आरोग्यपूर्ण माणसाची सामान्य तापमान अक्सर 37.0 °C असते, जे मेट्रिक प्रणालीतील मानक आहे. 98.6 °C एक फारेनहाइट मापन आहे आणि मेट्रिक मानक मूल्य नाही. उरलेल्या विकल्पांमध्ये 32.0 °C आणि 27.0 °C हे सामान्य शारीरिक तापमानपेक्षा जास्त कमी असतात आणि हायपोथर्मिया दर्शवतात.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi terminology for temperature and medical terms.

distractorReason: Confuses body temperature with room temperature or cold water temperature
questions.critique: The correct answer is 37.0 °C, which is the standard normal body temperature in Celsius. The other options represent common misconceptions, such as confusing Fahrenheit with Celsius or mistaking room temperature for body temperature.

questions.stem: How can you tell if Komal's fever is measured on the Celsius scale or the Fahrenheit scale?
choices: By checking the scale of the thermometer used
By asking her how it feels
By looking at the numbers on the thermometer
questions.solution: The scale of the thermometer determines whether the temperature is measured in Celsius or Fahrenheit. The other options are not reliable ways to determine the scale used.

questions.stem: Which type of thermometer is used for measuring body temperature?
questions.solution: A clinical thermometer is designed specifically for measuring body temperature, as it has a narrow range that is accurate for human body temperatures. Laboratory thermometers are used for a wider range of temperatures in experiments, room thermometers are for general environmental temperature, and thermocouples are used in industrial or high-temperature settings.

questions.stem: A laboratory thermometer is used to measure the temperature of a liquid. If the liquid is at 40°C, and the thermometer's range is from -10°C to 110°C, what is the maximum temperature it can measure?
questions.solution: The range of the thermometer is from -10°C to 110°C, which means the maximum temperature it can measure is 110°C. The other options are either the minimum temperature, the current temperature, or not the maximum value. The correct answer is the upper limit of the thermometer's range.

questions.stem: A student recorded the temperature of boiling water as 100 °C. What can be said about this reading?
questions.solution: The temperature of water remains constant while it is boiling, which is typically 100 °C at standard atmospheric pressure. Therefore, the reading of 100 °C is correct. Other options are incorrect because the temperature may vary under different conditions, but the reading itself is not inherently wrong.

hi.stem: एक छात्र ने उबलते पानी के तापमान को 100 °C लिखा। इस पाठ्य के बारे में क्या कहा जा सकता है?
hi.solution: जब पानी उबल रहा होता है तो उसका तापमान निरंतर रहता है, जो सामान्य वायुमंडलीय दबाव पर लगभग 100 °C होता है। अतः 100 °C का पाठ्य सही है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि विभिन्न स्थितियों में तापमान भिन्न हो सकता है, लेकिन पाठ्य स्वयं गलत नहीं है।
